scope: Automatic LLM resume screening, structured candidate resume form, and removal of duplicate/manual-shortlist UI

automated.result: Production build, server/client TypeScript checks and 153 tests in 14 suites passed.
automated.coverage: Semantic evidence contracts, blank/invented/incorrectly attributed quotes, required and optional criteria, missing AI results, durable retries, duplicate applies, multiple workers, expired leases, authorization, application-stage changes, frozen JD/profile evidence and legacy/structured profile persistence.

liveAi.result: Local configured Qwen/Ollama returned an evidence-supported 100% match for the synthetic Java/Spring Boot/MySQL/REST APIs candidate with 3 years against a 2-year requirement.

browser.environment: Temporary isolated MongoDB; API 4001, website 5174; synthetic candidate and company accounts only.
passed: Saved named education, work experience and project entries; refreshed and confirmed persistence.
Changed the company threshold and received a successful job save.
Applied through the UI and observed automatic screening progress.
Final real-LLM run on structured profile plus PDF changed the new application to Shortlisted with a 100% score and 80% threshold, without a manual shortlist action.
Company application details display criterion evidence and a single interview-rounds section.
Resume and screening result views checked in both light and dark mode.
Resume form checked at mobile 390px and tablet 820px. Measured document widths equal viewport client widths, with no horizontal document overflow.
Final company browser error log was empty.

dataSafety: Normal recruitment data was neither used for fixtures nor reset. Older applications retain legacy scores unless an eligible application is explicitly queued for its first AI assessment.
limits: LLM judgments and self-reported qualifications are not independently verified. The example's 100% match is not a model-accuracy claim.
Provider failures remain visibly queued/failed and do not receive fabricated scores or automatic rejections.
Oversized or uncertain evidence requires further review; no automatic shortlist is made.
The existing large Monaco bundle warning remains. External services and physical interview-device limits documented elsewhere are unchanged.
